summary: Cycle 22 of Phase 5 (suppression audit), the sole remaining open workstream on this task, and the final cycle of this /orchestrate invocation's budget. Started at Soundness.lean per the delegation's continuation note and worked down the count-3 tier smaller-first, then opportunistically continued into the count-2 tier once the count-3 worklist ran dry. Processed 10 files, all committed individually after a clean scoped rebuild plus downstream-importer rebuilds. Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Soundness/Soundness.lean (845->869 lines, 3->0, commit 37ac7f38): removal surfaced 25 unusedSimpArgs sites (simp only [Formula.and, Formula.neg, truthAt] / [..., Formula.or, ...] reduced to simp only [truthAt] or [Formula.neg] per-site) and 26 longLine sites (theorem signatures and match-arm exact-term lines wrapped onto indented continuation lines). Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Decidability/Saturation.lean (708 lines, 3->0, commit efb08c0e): removal surfaced 15 longLine sites plus 1 bare-simp linter.flexible site (simp [SignedFormula.neg] at h_mem) narrowed to a declaration-scoped set_option linter.flexible false in placed above the doc comment (a first attempt placed it below the doc comment and hit the known cycle-12 parse hazard, caught and corrected before commit). Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/BXCanonical/Chronicle/ChronicleTypes.lean (578 lines, 3->0, commit 74fec4d4): the Bimodal counterpart of the Temporal ChronicleTypes.lean closed cycle 21 -- confirmed the identical structure/c0-c5' dupNamespace-narrowing pattern transfers exactly (14 sites narrowed via declaration-scoped set_option linter.dupNamespace false in on the Chronicle structure and its condition defs, modulo an extra fc : FrameClass parameter on some conditions changing doc-comment wrap points but not the strategy) plus ~39 longLine wraps across doc comments, structure field assignments, and have-statement type annotations. Cslib/Foundations/Logic/Metalogic/Chronicle/SinceSeedConsistency.lean (1072 lines, 3->0, commit 1a14739f): despite being the largest file processed this cycle, turned out cheap -- only 7 genuine linter.flexible sites surfaced across 5 declarations (bare simp [...] at h calls narrowed to declaration-scoped suppressions), and the blanket style.setOption/unusedSimpArgs suppressions were both entirely unnecessary (zero warnings on removal). Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Bundle/FMCSDef.lean (43 lines, 2->0, commit 13515a71), Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/BXCanonical/CanonicalChain.lean (92 lines, 2->0, commit 3d50f988), Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/FrameConditions/Compatibility.lean (105 lines, 2->0, commit a2c7f2f1), Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Bundle/Construction.lean (123 lines, 2->0, commit 16d312b4): four small count-2-tier files, each with only 1-8 mechanical longLine wraps and no downstream importers, taken opportunistically once the count-3 tier ran dry. Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Bundle/UntilSinceCoherence.lean (127 lines, 2->0, commit c0a2c843): 2 longLine wraps; the file's 2 pre-existing sorries (guarded by set_option warn.sorry false, blocked on upstream continuous-frame completeness) were left completely untouched, confirming they fall outside a hygiene-only task's scope and do not interact with the linter.-prefixed suppression categories this task targets. Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Bundle/BFMCS.lean (130 lines, 2->0, commit c8fa93ef): 1 longLine wrap. Suppression-audit progress: 268 -> 278 sites audited cumulative (68 files fully processed). Live re-derived local-only in-scope count: 72 blanket suppressions across 49 files (down from 96/59 at cycle 21 close -- 24 sites / 10 files this cycle). The count-3, count-4, and count-5 tiers are now all fully cleared; only count-6 (1 file, Interface.lean, deliberately deferred) and the count-2/count-1 tail (49 files total) remain. Also re-baselined the check-lint-suppressions.sh ratchet (commit 851278c7), which had drifted stale across several prior cycles -- now correctly locks in 86 blanket suppressions across 63 files repo-wide (72/49 local-only in-scope). Plan updated throughout (RESUME HERE fully rewritten with a live re-derived survey of the entire remaining count-2 (19 files) and count-1 (30 files) tiers plus per-file line/suppression counts, Phase 5 header, header stats, next-target pointer, a Phase-5-body 'Done (cycle 21)' backfill entry and 'Done (cycle 22)' entry, 5 new findings this cycle plus cycle-20/21 findings carried forward). Full CSLib CI pipeline re-run at cycle end and confirmed green: lake build --wfail --iofail exactly 5 baseline sorry warnings (zero new, matching the documented baseline), checkInitImports clean, lint-style clean, mk_all no update necessary, lake shake exactly the 12 upstream-shared files (zero local-only findings), lake lint zero matches on the 7 prevention categories across the whole repo -- only out-of-scope unusedArguments findings remain (147 errors, unchanged category, not this task's target), lake test exit 0, check-lint-suppressions.sh exit 0 (86, baseline ceiling 86). Vacuous-def grep unchanged at the single pre-existing false positive. Axiom count unchanged at 26. git diff on all of this cycle's Lean-file commits individually confirmed zero sorry lines touched and no proof term/definition/theorem statement altered. This is the final cycle of this /orchestrate invocation's budget; the task remains PARTIAL pending a fresh /implement or /orchestrate dispatch to continue.

decisions_made: Per the delegation's continuation note, started with Soundness.lean (845 lines, next count-3-tier target per smaller-files-first), then worked down: Saturation.lean (708), BXCanonical/Chronicle/ChronicleTypes.lean (578), SinceSeedConsistency.lean (1072, the largest of the count-3 tier, deliberately saved for last within the tier).

Once the count-3 tier's tracked worklist ran dry mid-cycle, continued opportunistically into the count-2 tier with several very small files (43-130 lines) rather than stopping, since they were near-free single- or few-warning fixes -- this materially increased this cycle's file-throughput (10 files vs. the ~5-7/cycle historical average) and is recorded as a new finding for future cycles.

For Soundness.lean's 25 unusedSimpArgs sites, verified via the collected warning list per site (not assumption) that every simp only [Formula.and, Formula.neg, truthAt] / [..., Formula.or, ...] site had Formula.and/or/neg genuinely unused, then reduced with two replace_all edits (one per exact-match group) plus one single-site edit for the outlier simp only [Formula.neg, truthAt].

For Saturation.lean's single bare-simp linter.flexible site, used declaration-scoped set_option linter.flexible false in per the cycle-20 rule for bare simp [X] pulling the full default simp set -- caught and corrected a first-attempt placement error (set_option placed after the doc comment instead of before it), confirming the cycle-12/16 parse-hazard finding still recurs and must be actively guarded against, not just remembered.

For BXCanonical/Chronicle/ChronicleTypes.lean, did not re-derive the dupNamespace-narrowing strategy from scratch -- reused the exact pattern from the Temporal counterpart closed cycle 21 (per-declaration set_option linter.dupNamespace false in above each doc comment, structure + c0-c5' conditions), confirming the cycle-21 prediction that this transfers directly.

For SinceSeedConsistency.lean, did not assume its large line count implied heavy remaining-warning volume -- removed all 3 blanket suppressions first and re-derived the actual warning set live, which showed only 7 genuine flexible sites and zero setOption/unusedSimpArgs warnings; recorded as a new finding that line count does not predict remaining-warning count.

For UntilSinceCoherence.lean, explicitly verified via grep that the file's 2 pre-existing sorries are guarded by set_option warn.sorry false (a distinct suppression mechanism from the linter.-prefixed categories this task targets) and left them completely untouched -- confirmed no sorry was discharged, added, or relocated.

Ran the full 8-step CSLib CI pipeline (build --wfail --iofail, checkInitImports, lint-style, mk_all, lake shake, lake lint, lake test, sorry/axiom/vacuous grep census) once at cycle close, in addition to the mandatory per-file scoped rebuild + downstream-importer rebuild before each commit, matching this dispatch's explicit hard constraint of committing only when each file is green.

Discovered the check-lint-suppressions.sh ratchet baseline had drifted stale across several prior cycles (last updated well before cycle 21) and re-baselined it in its own commit, verifying the ratchet gate still reports a clean, monotonically-decreasing result (86, baseline ceiling 86) rather than silently leaving the gain unlocked.

Fully rewrote the plan's RESUME HERE section rather than appending another entry on top of the existing one, since this is explicitly the final cycle of this /orchestrate invocation's budget and the instruction was to leave a complete, cold-startable resume point including a fresh survey of the count-2/count-1 tail (19 + 30 files, individually line-counted and suppression-counted) -- prior RESUME HERE entries are preserved in git history, not lost.

Did not re-investigate Phase 7's two carried-forward blockers, since this dispatch's continuation note scoped work to Phase 5 only and those items are settled awaiting a human decision, not further investigation.

Did not attempt the count-6 tier's sole remaining file (Interface.lean, 3048 lines) this cycle, per its established deliberate-deferral status -- the count-2/count-1 tail's many small, mostly single-fix files offered materially better sites-cleared-per-tool-call throughput this cycle, and Interface.lean remains flagged as needing a cycle with a large context budget specifically reserved for it.
